name: screensaver

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the widest spread of drifting photos with the headline fully clear.

tagline: Small photos drift and bounce around a fixed headline like a DVD logo.
summary: A set of square images floats around a container, each travelling in a straight line and reversing at the edges, while centred text stays still behind the motion.
appearance: A near-black stage with a white 'page not found' headline at its centre. Around and behind it, about a dozen small square photos in mixed colours drift in a loose diagonal band, some clipped at the top edge.
behaviour: Every photo moves at a steady speed along a straight diagonal and reverses when it reaches a container edge, so each one keeps bouncing. The headline stays fixed while photos pass behind it.
demo_content: Eight Unsplash photos, doubled, behind the heading 'page not found'.
search_phrases: elements that bounce off container edges
use_when: A 404 or empty page needs gentle ambient movement so it does not feel dead, without pulling focus from the message.
avoid_when: It never idles, so it can drain battery and distract on a long page, and it needs a sized overflow-hidden parent.
customise: Each instance takes its content as children plus speed, start angle, start position as percentages and the container ref; colours and image sources are whatever you pass in.
weight_why: Sixteen photos each update their position every frame through motion values.

a11y.note: The nonstop motion never pauses or checks reduced-motion preferences, and it is purely decorative with no controls.

polish_why: The bounce and layering work cleanly, but the effect is a stock idea with plain square photos.
